messages:
devon: Kicking off prod deploy for inference-gateway v3.2.0 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Canary -> 10% traffic. deploybot: Deploy started: canary=10% | coords: #deploys | logs: https://logs.redwood/prod/inf-gw/2027604321 :rocket:
alex: quick question — any DB schema changes in this rollout?
devon: no schema work, only model pin (v3.2.0) + routing flag. No migrations.
maria: Important: if p95 latency > 350ms for 5+ min OR error rate spikes > 1%, we abort canary and pin back to v3.1.9. Put that in the runbook. :rotating_light:
sam: Agreed. + add automated fallback route to dedicated pool if region starts failing.
devon: noted. Backout plan is runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/backout-model-pin — contains rollback CLI and checklist.
alex: Copying the rollback snippet here for quick access:
```
# rollback to previous pinned version
redwoodctl pin --service inference-gateway --version v3.1.9 --reason "canary abort"
redwoodctl throttle --route canary --to 0%  # stop canary traffic
```
deploybot: Canary health update (5m): p95=285ms, errors=0.18%, saturation CPU=42% | traces: https://traces.redwood/2027604321
maria: Looks healthy so far. Proceed to 50% canary when ready.
devon: Gradually moving to 50% over next 10m. Will monitor p95/error and rollback if threshold crossed.
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall is paged for any infra-level troubles during change window.
sam: Also flagging cost-optimized batching change in this deploy — watch token/sec for requester A.
devon: 50% reached. Monitoring.
deploybot: Canary at 50% | p95=310ms, errors=0.25% | panels: https://dash.redwood/canary/2027604321
alex: p95 creeping but still under 350ms. Keep an eye on tail latency.
maria: If p95 holds under 340ms for 10m, green to full rollout. If it hits 360ms for 2 continuous minutes, execute backout.
devon: Understood. Performing another health pull in 5m.
(4m later)
deploybot: Alert: p95=365ms for 3m, errors=0.9% — threshold breached.
devon: Initiating abort and rollback to pinned v3.1.9 now.
alex: Copy. Execute rollback snippet.
```
redwoodctl pin --service inference-gateway --version v3.1.9 --reason "auto-abort: latency regression"
redwoodctl throttle --route canary --to 0%
redwoodctl rollout --type immediate --scope global
```
maria: I confirmed the pin command succeeded, routing back to v3.1.9. Watching metrics for stabilization.
deploybot: Rollback complete. Current pinned version: v3.1.9 | canary=0% | incidents: none automated.
sam: Thanks team. Postmortem note: investigate batching threshold change and interaction with model cache.
devon: I'll open an issue and link the canary traces + runbook steps. Link will be attached to the release notes.
alex: Also add a short blurb in the change log explaining why we aborted to save other teams digging.
oncall-bot: Change window closed. If follow-ups needed, ping oncall. :wave:
